title: Implement Find Replaceable Types And Designs For Pieces In Design
description: Implement findReplaceableTypesAndDesignsForPiecesInDesign algorithm across all languages (TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, C#). The algorithm suggests replaceable types/designs for selected pieces based on port compatibility of their connections.
summary: Refactored replaceable-kind/design matching to use one connector-level boundary requirement multiset per selection, with injective connector matching, actual opposite-side boundary connectors, conservative missing-port handling, and exposed candidate-design connectors only. Updated JS, Go, Python, and Rust tests with multiplicity-focused synthetic coverage and concrete Nakagin capsule-count acceptance cases.
